findings.title: No node matches the pod's node selector
findings.cause: the pod's required node affinity asks for kubernetes.io/arch in (arm64), and the nodes have amd64, which no node meets; Deployment web has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.detail: 0/1 nodes are available: 1 node(s) didn't match Pod's node affinity/selector. preemption: 0/1 nodes are available: 1 Preemption is not helpful for scheduling.

evidence.what: required node affinity: kubernetes.io/arch in (arm64), and the nodes have amd64
evidence.command: kubectl get pod web-d6f4d45d-msqgb -n kd-node-affinity-no-match -o jsonpath='{.spec.affinity.nodeAffinity}'

findings.fix: Label a node to match (kubectl label node), or correct the pod's nodeSelector or affinity.
